_comment: Role table — tenant-scoped business roles (e.g. supervisor, mechanic,
master engine builder, advisor). Distinct from Cognito group — Cognito
groups are limited to SHOP_ADMIN / MECHANIC / CLIENT; every MECHANIC
staff member is additionally assigned a business role from this table
via Staff.role_id. See app/service/models.py in fastapi-sam for the
No GSIs — roles are always listed/read within a single tenant via the
main-table PK prefix: PK = TENANT#x AND begins_with(SK, 'ROLE#')
